messages.subject: Extra Constrain in INLA
parts:
Dear all,

I know in inla ,  f(.., constr=T,extraconstr=extraconstraint,..)  will give me a "sum to zero" constrain plus an "extra constrain". 

My question is if my "extra constrain" contains the  "sum to zero" constrain, can I write the formula like f(.., constr=F,extraconstr=extraconstraint,..)
or I must write it as f(.., constr=T,extraconstr=extraconstraint,..). 

Since the output of these two formula forms are different, I am really confused.

Many Thanks,
Jun

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Extra Constrain in INLA
parts:
if you add constr=T and this constraint will be added to your
extraconstr. this happens internally.

H
